texte:
This season, embark on a culinary journey to Brittany, a small region in France known for its bold character!
Rich in flavor and proud of its roots, Brittany brings authentic dishes straight to your table - whether you choose to dine in, take away, or even enjoy them at your private events. A unique, friendly, and delicious experience awaits you!

Find our Breton cuisine in Mendoza, Argentina, from October to the end of December 2025, and again from March to May 2026.
For a summer filled with delicious flavors, we'll be in Punta del Este, Uruguay, from late December 2025 to the end of February 2026.
Find us soon on Instagram to follow our adventure!

titre: Enjoy the Timeless Taste of French Cuisine
texte:
Crêpes
A true icon of Breton gastronomy, the crêpe comes in sweet or plain versions, with a delicate, thin batter made from soft wheat flour.Topped with your favorite flavors - Nutella, fresh strawberries, dulce de leche, or homemade salted butter caramel - it promises a sweet moment of tradition and indulgence.

Galettes
A savory specialty from Brittany, the galette is made with buckwheat flour, giving it a rustic texture and authentic taste. Generously filled with egg, ham, and melted cheese, it's perfect any time of day - a flavorful journey straight to the heart of Brittany.

Quiche Lorraine
Originating from the Lorraine region of France, this classic dish features a flaky pastry crust filled with a rich blend of fresh cream, eggs, and smoked bacon. Best enjoyed warm or at room temperature, served with a crisp salad - a simple, elegant, and satisfying bite of French tradition.
Find us soon on Instagram to follow our adventure!

titre: The essence of our culinary adventure
texte:
From Bretagne to Mendoza, our roots sing with unique flavors. It is around this shared passion for our distinctive terroirs that our life project took shape, ultimately becoming a two-voice nomadic culinary adventure.
Our goal is to bring each hemisphere the iconic specialties of our regions, making the most of the summer seasons to keep our activity vibrant all year round.

To promote the cuisine of our regions in France and South America, blending the authenticity of Brittany with the generosity of Argentine culture.
To grow and establish our concepts in both hemispheres by developing a seasonal food truck franchise network

titre: The values that shape our project
texte:
To offer a unique culinary experience to each hemisphere by sharing the flavors of Brittany with Argentinians and the specialties of the Andes with the French, through homemade cuisine that is generous and full of character.
We serve authentic dishes: Galettes, Crêpes, Lomitos, and Empanadas inspired by both continents, prepared with fresh, local, and responsibly sourced ingredients.
Aboard our food truck, we connect with people in France, Argentina, and Uruguay, following the rhythm of the tourist seasons — at markets, festivals, and private events—to share more than just a meal: a culture, a fusion of flavors, and a warm, memorable moment.
